The Incredible Dr. Pol T23 - Ep. 2

Dr. Pol treats three bovines and one tiny rabbit before heading to the Netherlands with Diane to celebrate his 80th birthday. Just because the Docs away, it doesnt mean that the clinic slows down. A very vocal pig needs surgery to treat a hernia, a blocked cat is in pain and requires immediate relief, and a puppy is feeling the effects of eating something inedible. .
The Incredible Dr. Pol T23 - Ep. 4

The Fair is in full swing! Getting to this day took months of hard work from vets and kids to get the Fair animals in tip top shape. Even after the Fair opens, the vets are on call to treat any emergency that pops up. Dr. Pol treats a goat with a torn ear as Dr. Lisa examines a limping cow. At the clinic, Dr. Nicole is tireless in her effort to save the life of a beloved dog.
The Incredible Dr. Pol T23 - Ep. 6

Its the most wonderful time of the year! As PVS decks the halls, a reindeers hurt hoof threatens his Christmas Eve take-off. Dr. Pol treats an abandoned puppy discovered on a cold silent night. Dr. Nicole rushes to a cow that isnt acting right while Dr. Lisa assists a young cat struggling to breathe.
Killer Safari T1 - Ep. 1

Lions kill four buffaloes in a stampede, while in another drying river a buffalo fights off five of the big cats. As the dry winter looms, heading out on a game drive means checking in at all the remaining waterholes. This is where the action plays out. Each event is unpacked and explained, offering a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.
Germany's Magic Mountains T1 - Ep. 2

The quiet charm of Germany’s Central Uplands lies in ancient forests and wild beauty. Through the autumn forest, the booming call of a stag echoes through the mist. It’s rutting season! In Saxon Switzerland, peregrine falcons and black storks inhabit picturesque cliffs. The elusive lynx roams the forests, while in the Harz, a new, wilder forest is growing in the shifting climate.
Portugal's Wild Wonders T1 - Ep. 1

At the western end of the Mediterranean lies Portugal, full of diverse ecosystems that showcase a stunning array of species both big and small, many of which are endemic to the region. Its interconnected web allows each creature a way to survive the rugged landscape. A fire salamander that can live up to 50 years enjoys its first meal after spending a dormant summer underground.
Portugal's Wild Wonders T1 - Ep. 2

Life on the coast of Portugal is full of beauty and brutality for the unique animals that live there, from the smallest phytoplankton to the giant sperm whales. Fiddler crabs fight for breeding rights in the coastal lagoons. Cuttlefish, the ultimate masters of disguise, creep in on unsuspecting prey. Storks perch precariously on the Atlantic cliffs, protecting their chicks from predators.
Gredos - King Of The Mountains - Ep. 1

Through the cycle of the seasons, Spain’s Sierra de Gredos National Park, one of Europe’s most remarkable natural landscapes, is revealed. From ancient glacial cirques and deep mountain ravines to the summit of Almanzor, the highest peak in central Spain, discover a unique and fragile ecosystem. Here, the Spanish ibex, an iconic species that defines the spirit of these mountains, reigns.

Lion T1 - Ep. 2

Against all odds, Kio survives a buffalo attack, but his troubles are far from over. At 12 weeks old, he is the youngest and most vulnerable member of the pride. To have any hope of one day becoming king, he must earn the respect of his older brothers and find his place among them. Just as he is finally able to gain their acceptance, the dry season sets in, and food becomes scarce.

June must deal with orphaned pup, Vince, as he tries to join her burrow. Over in the Highlands, Scarlett's fearless pups go in search of two badgers, a choice with deadly consequences.

The Prairie Dogs of northern New Mexico deal with all kinds of threats, big and small. In the Flatlands, June faces an infestation of fleas.

On this special episode of “The Incredible Dr. Pol,” Michigan’s most trusted vets are always on call, because animal emergencies don’t wait for business hours. From a cat attacked by a raccoon to a pig struggling with farrowing, the team tackles a wide range of urgent cases — Dr. Pol even heeds the call for a dangerously distressed horse and saves a Chihuahua’s vision after a scuffle.
The Incredible Dr. Pol T23 - Ep. 8

Surprises come in all scrapes and sizes. A cockatiel has a tweaked beak and Dr. Lisa ponders a barn cats bladder leak. When a Chihuahua arrives after hours with an eye emergency, Doc remains focused. A serious blemish surfaces on a show dog and a hoarse horse struggles to breathe. Everyone comes together to make Dianes birthday extra special.

Lake Of A Thousand Caiman - Ep. 1

Deep in the heart of the Amazon, an uncharted lake emerges every dry season when the floodwaters recede. It's rumoured that this secret lair lures reptiles little changed since the time of the dinosaurs.
Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara - Ep. 1

Each year, nearly two million wildebeest and zebra cross the Serengeti on a quest for fresh grazing. But two legendary rivers stand in their way—the Grumeti and the Mara—each ruled by a formidable dynasty of Nile crocodiles. In “Croc Wars,” follow these ancient predators as they prepare for the feast of the year, but not all crocodiles are created equal.

Reptiles are like scaly monsters from another time. As scientists unlock their secrets, the more remarkable they become.
Crocodile - Australia's Greatest Survivor - Ep. 1

In Australia, dominant saltwater crocodiles, called 'boss crocs,” are the largest and most powerful animals on the continent. Even after unrelenting human pressure on their very survival, they are still the masters of their world. Over the last 200 years, the impact of human activities—such as commercial hunting, agriculture and population growth—pushed them to the brink of extinction.
Day Of The Dragon - Ep. 1

The clock starts just before sunrise - when the temperature begins to rise. It’s hard work being the world’s biggest lizard on Rinca island. Competition is so fierce he can’t afford to slow down. For the biggest male on the island, an ever- warming environment and shrinking hunting grounds threaten his survival across every hour of the day.
Crocodiles Of The Okavango - Ep. 1

In Botswana’s Okavango Delta, a young Nile crocodile embarks on her first season of motherhood. After winning the chance to breed, she faces fierce competition for nesting territory and the challenge of safeguarding her eggs through months of flooding, searing heat and relentless predators. Monitor lizards, mongooses, baboons and rival crocodiles all threaten her nest while she stands guard.
Predator V Prey T1 - Ep. 3

A forensic look at how Nile crocodiles hunt, offering new perspectives on the patient and precise tactics they use when ambushing migratory herds of wildebeest and zebra that pass through their territories. A male crocodile must target large prey in a bid to survive the harshest time of the year.
